messages:
maya: quick design review — primary CTA on the datasets list feels visually flat and a bit hard to tap on mobile. also seeing toasts truncate long dataset names mid-word (attached screenshot). any quick wins?

maya: (attached: datasets-list-toast-cutoff.png)

tim: +1. on my phone the action button is tiny. i checked, the token is `component.button.touch = 36px` right now. we should bump to 44px min touch target per a11y.

alex: 44px makes sense. if we increase padding we might push row height. alternative: add subtle elevation (`elevation.surface-1`) to primary CTA to improve affordance without changing layout too much.

maya: i sketched two options: 1) bump vertical padding by 2px (so internal vertical padding 8->10), border-radius +2, 2) keep padding, add 1dp shadow and slightly darker border. which do folks prefer?

samir: shadow feels lower-risk for spacing, but we need to test dark mode since shadows can read differently. can we get quick before/after images?

design-bot: a11y scan: recommended min touch target is 44x44. Contrast check: default primary on light bg PASS, fails for alt-surface (#f4f6f8) in dark-mode-sim. See report (auto-generated).

alex: for toasts — long names should ellipsize and expose full name on hover/focus. suggest CSS: 
```
.toast .label { max-width: 320px; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; overflow: hidden; }
.toast .label[title] { cursor: help; }
```
and set `title` attribute for desktop; add aria tooltip for keyboard.

maya: yes — tooltip on focus for keyboard is important. use `aria-describedby` to link to an accessible tooltip element, not just `title`.

tim: let's also add a small utility class to make retrofitting easier:
```
.touch-target { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
```
use this for table row actions so icons aren't painful to tap.

samir: one more nit — if we increase row padding to hit 44px we break compact rows. we should add a density token `spacing.row-compact` vs `spacing.row-default` and toggle in settings. avoids global regressions.

maya: plan: i'll prototype the shadow + add `touch-target` to actions. alex — can you implement ellipsize + tooltip behavior (desktop hover and focus for keyboard)? tim/samir — quick perf check on list render if we add `touch-target` wrappers. aim to ship in next patch.

alex: @maya :thumbsup: i'll open a PR for the toast text truncation + accessible tooltip. question — should toast animation be `fade` or `slide`? i think slide-from-top is more discoverable for lists.

tim: slide-from-top feels better for discoverability, +1.

maya: cool. i'll update Figma (two variants) and post screenshots here when done. thanks all. :sparkles:
